Portronics Hexacharge Wireless Charger – Smart 6 in 1 Charging & Desk Solution

The Portronics Hexacharge Wireless Charger is a modern, multi-functional desktop accessory designed for users who value efficiency, organization, and style. Combining wireless charging, a digital alarm clock, LED lamp, and pen stand into a single compact unit, this smart device transforms your workspace into a clutter-free and productive environment.

Finished in an elegant black color, the Hexacharge blends seamlessly with home offices, corporate desks, study tables, and bedside setups. Whether you are charging your smartphone, managing your daily schedule, or illuminating your workspace, this delivers convenience and performance in one sleek design.

6 in 1 Wireless Charger with Intelligent Design

This is thoughtfully engineered to meet multiple everyday needs. It supports fast wireless charging with an output power of 15W, making it suitable for Qi-enabled smartphones from leading brands. The built-in digital alarm clock ensures you stay punctual, while the integrated LED lamp provides soft yet effective lighting for work or reading. A dedicated keeps your writing essentials neatly organized, reducing desk clutter and improving productivity. With its minimalist layout and compact footprint, the Hexacharge is ideal for both professional and personal use.

Fast Wireless Charging with Type-C Input

Equipped with a modern Type-C input, the ensures stable power delivery and enhanced charging efficiency. The 15W wireless output allows faster charging compared to standard wireless pads, while built-in safety features protect against overheating, over-voltage, and short circuits. Simply place your compatible smartphone on the charging surface and enjoy hassle-free, cable-free charging. This makes it a perfect solution for office desks, nightstands, and shared workspaces.

Digital Alarm Clock with LED Display

The integrated digital alarm clock features a clear LED display that shows time at a glance, even in low-light conditions. It is ideal for professionals, students, and anyone who needs a reliable timekeeping solution on their desk or bedside table. The adjustable LED lamp adds functionality by providing focused lighting without straining your eyes, making it suitable for late-night work, reading, or study sessions.

Premium Build & Modern Black Finish

Crafted with durability in mind, the Hexacharge features a sturdy build and a premium black finish that enhances its modern appeal. The clean design complements both corporate and home interiors, making it an excellent gifting option for employees, clients, and tech enthusiasts.
